title: Title card burned into the talking-head edit
caption: A title card burned into the top of the talking-head edit with mgvideo title, in Magnifito's brand: the name and a one-line subtitle in Geist on a cream card with a green accent stripe, sized for the 1080p frame and on screen for the whole clip.
prompt: Burn a title card into 7 seconds of ../videos/03-talking-head-edit.mp4 (from 2 s to 9 s): "Meet Mira from Magnifito" with the subtitle "Digital marketing agency, Sofia", placed at the top so it does not cover her face or the captions. Use the Magnifito brand: cream card (#f0eadf), dark brown title (#2b1c17), brown subtitle (#7a584c), a green accent (#8acf31) and Geist from fonts/. Keep the audio and save it as work/titled.mp4.
commands: mgvideo title work/source.mp4 --title "Meet Mira from Magnifito" --subtitle "Digital marketing agency, Sofia" --position top --bg '#f0eadf' --color '#2b1c17' --subtitle-color '#7a584c' --accent '#8acf31' --font-file fonts/Geist-Variable.ttf --title-size 44 --subtitle-size 24 --out work/titled.mp4
credits: Video and audio: 03-talking-head-edit from this showcase (synthetic presenter and generated voice-like tone track; Geist typeface by Vercel, SIL OFL 1.1)
